_comment: Hand-written WRONG or UNSUPPORTED claims (not from an LLM). Citations point at the real span the claim twists, so they get the same premise as real claims. Gold labels in labels.csv.

claims.claim: Timeouts in urllib3 are specified in milliseconds.
claims.citation: Timeouts allow you to control how long (in seconds) requests are allowed to run

claims.claim: A urllib3 Timeout instance only lets you specify a single combined timeout for connect and read.
claims.citation: lets you specify separate connect and read timeouts

claims.claim: A timeout set at the urllib3 PoolManager level cannot be overridden for an individual request.
claims.citation: You still override this pool-level timeout by specifying `timeout` to `request()`.

claims.claim: In urllib3, a timeout can only be given as a Timeout instance, not as a float.
claims.citation: you can specify a timeout as a `float` to `request()`

claims.claim: The default timeout of urllib3 requests is 3 seconds.
claims.citation: If you want all requests to be subject to the same timeout

claims.claim: urllib3 raises a ReadTimeoutError directly when a request exceeds its timeout.
claims.citation: requests are allowed to run before being aborted
